in_reply_to.description: The request this answers, when it answers one.

producer_sequence.description: Per producer, strictly increasing. A gap means messages were lost.

ActionIntent.description: A bounded sequence of primitives with a fixed end.

attempt_id.description: Correlates the intent with a host attempt; the device treats it as opaque.

binding_fingerprint.description:
Digest of the bound instance's fingerprint, checked against what is
under the pointer immediately before a pointer or AX primitive.

root_epoch.description: The root cancellation epoch this action was admitted under.

ActionSummary.description: One action that needs its own confirmation.

confidence_milli.description: The backend's own figure, not a calibrated probability.

AxActionKind.description: What an accessibility action does to the bound element.

oneOf.description: Absolute: repeating it leaves the same value.

AxActionName.description:
The accessibility actions an element declares. Values are not part of the
declaration; they belong to the action that is submitted.

oneOf.description: Scripted input backend; no real input is produced.

CapabilityManifest.description:
What this device can really do right now. Never a statement about what the
platform could do in principle.

max_uninterruptible_ms.description: Longest stretch that cannot be interrupted once submitted.

CommandAck.description: Generic reply for commands that only need an accept or reject.

Configure.description: What a supervisor tells a process it started.

ConfirmationResult.description: A confirmation covers exactly what it showed and nothing beyond it.

ConfirmationScope.description:
How much the user asked to have confirmed. The two are separate claims:
seeing the state again in the UI is not proof that it was committed.

oneOf.description: Global display points, origin at the top-left of the main display.
Required state was cut to fit; the answer is not usable.

DecisionSource.description: Who actually made a semantic choice. Every consumed choice has exactly one.

oneOf.description: A step the installed plan fixed, with no branch at run time.
A deterministic workflow or rule.
The local fast model.
The cloud model standing in for the S1 slot.
A choice obtained by escalating to the planner.

DecisionState.description: The bounded projection sent to a decision backend.

omitted_items.description: What was dropped to fit the budget. Empty when nothing was.

DependencyUpdate.description: The host tells the device a dependency changed. `valid: None` means unknown.

DependencyVersions.description: Current dependency revisions, returned after an update.

DeviceIdentity.description:
Who the device is in this session. The host builds device evidence from it,
so it must match what the device itself checks.

dependencies.description: Current dependency revisions. Later changes arrive as device events.

EffectClass.description:
What acting on a control may change. Declared order is the order of
severity, and `Unknown` is deliberately the most restrictive value.

oneOf.description: Sends, publishes, pays or changes account security. Not executed in phase 1.
No trusted source could classify it.

FailureCode.description:
Why an action, decision or task did not go the normal way.

These are distinct outcomes, not flavours of "low confidence": each one
drives a different recovery path.

FrameMeta.description:
Metadata of one captured frame. The pixels travel on a separate bounded
binary channel and are not part of this message.

oneOf.description: The display did not change; the source is alive.

GoalSummary.description: A goal in words the user can check before anything runs.

GrantPermit.description: Asks the device to issue a permit for one target on fresh evidence.

token.description: One-time credential delivered over the inherited private pipe.

LeaseRenew.description:
The host keeps its control lease alive. When the lease lapses the device
closes its submit gate on its own.

oneOf.description: Accepted only by the simulated backend.

Modifiers.description:
Modifier keys travel as event flags on an atomic primitive. They are never
pressed on their own, so a dead device cannot leave one held down.

Observation.description: Evidence as the device sees it: a scoped, time-limited claim about one target.

oneOf.description: Cancels the root. `None` cancels whatever is running.

PolicyChoice.description: What a backend proposes. It is only ever a proposal.

oneOf.description: Needs a fresh observation before it can be considered.
Atomic: down and up are submitted in one critical section.
Atomic key press with modifier flags.

PrimitivePolicy.description: Whether held-class primitives may be submitted at all.

oneOf.description: Phase 1 production: only atomic primitives.
Simulator and later phases: dragging, long presses, held keys.

ProcessIdentity.description: A pid alone does not identify a process; the start time disambiguates reuse.

QueryReceipt.description: Asks for the current receipt of an intent, for example after a timeout.

Ready.description:
Sent once the peer has finished its own self-checks. Only a ready
capability may be used to admit dependent requests.

Rect.description: A rectangle in global display points, origin at the top-left of the main display.

ResumeCommand.description: An explicit user resume. Only an explicit resume lifts a pause.

RootGrant.description:
Registers a frozen root task with the device. The deadline and epoch come
from the host and are never reset by re-registration.

RootState.description: The root task states of design 13.5.

RunMode.description:
observe only collects; shadow also records suggestions; execute submits
authorised input. No model can raise the mode.

SimFault.description: A scripted fault for the simulated backend. Real backends reject these.

SimHitTest.description: What is under the pointer, as the simulated backend should report it.

oneOf.description: The bound element is under the pointer.
Something else is; the value is its fingerprint digest.
Pretend a person touched the keyboard or pointer.

SourceCommand.description: Commands the host may send to the source.

oneOf.description: Read the structure again now.

StateObject.description: One object as the model sees it: facts only, no hidden ids to interpret.

StopAck.description:
The device's answer to a stop. It goes to main and to the host, and its
`stop_seq` is what the host must echo as `acked_stop_seq` afterwards.

oneOf.description: Release the input but keep the root's semantic progress.
Cancel the root. The device keeps a tombstone for it.
The host stopped on its own: a deadline, the budget or a failure.

StopStatus.description: What the stop control shows. A click alone never turns into "stopped".

oneOf.description: The stop was requested but the device has not confirmed the release.

StructureSnapshot.description: One reading of the target application's UI tree.

active_layer.description:
The window that receives input. `None` means the source cannot tell,
and nothing that depends on it is admitted.

complete.description:
False when a read timed out or hit its traversal budget. Objects under
an incomplete read are unknown, not absent.

SubmitIntent.description: An intent plus the highest stop the sending host has processed.

group.description: Title of the nearest labelled group ancestor.

in_view.description: Inside the visible range of its scroll container.

value.description: Absent for secure fields: the value is never read, sent or stored.

UiProjection.description:
A bounded snapshot for the renderer, always re-derivable from host state.
The renderer never treats it as an execution receipt.

cleanup.description: Input cleanup as the device last reported it.
